body:
**Triage: `pm:blocked` + `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#3573` written into the body. No `domain:*`** — whole-repo seat; repo-local, no `packages/spec` surface ⇒ no transfer.

**Grading: real defect, and the block is sequencing only.** The trace is line-anchored and checks out on `origin/main` (baseline `632c07c5b`, page untouched since #3471):

```
packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx:579   onClick={() => navigate('/apps/setup')}  data-testid="go-to-settings-btn"
packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppSidebar.tsx:313    { id: 'sys-settings', … url: '/apps/setup' }
packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx:322 { id: 'sys-settings', … url: '/apps/setup' }
```

Three call sites, one wrong target — and `isSystemRoute` keying on `pathname.includes('/system')` is why the bare `/apps/setup` re-renders the very empty state the button sits on. On a zero-app deployment both buttons of the first screen are dead; #3573 fixes one of them.

**Why blocked.** **PR #3588 (open, for #3573) is editing this exact file right now**, and this card cannot be implemented without touching that PR's new test: `AppContent.noAppsCta.test.tsx` pins the current behaviour (*"leaves the sibling go-to-settings CTA on its absolute /apps/setup target"*). That assertion exists to prove #3573 did **not** touch this button — it is not an endorsement of the target, and this card's fix must rewrite it. Dispatching concurrently would mean two agents editing one file and one test in opposite directions. Unblock condition: **#3573 closes / #3588 merges** ⇒ drop `pm:blocked`, apply `pm:queue`.

**One correction the lane should carry forward:** #3573's body asserts this sibling button is fine "because it lands inside `/apps/:appName/*`". This card falsifies that — being inside the subtree is necessary, not sufficient. Worth a line in #3573's thread if its PR text repeats the claim.

**Dedupe** (three repos, issues + PRs): no duplicate. **#3573 / PR #3588** — sibling button, same empty state, now the recorded blocker. **#2794** — correctly excluded by the reporter (root-level `/_console/setup` deep link on an app-bearing deployment, a different mechanism); if both are worked in the same window, align on which URL is *the* stable settings entry point. The reporter's own keyword sweep is recorded in the body and was re-run from this seat: clean.

**Scope note for whoever takes it:** fix all three call sites (`AppContent.tsx:579`, `AppSidebar.tsx:313`, `UnifiedSidebar.tsx:322`) — `/apps/setup/system` is the reachable target, since `extraRoutesNoApp` mounts `SystemHubPage` only under the `isSystemRoute` branch.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

**认领**(PM 分诊晋级;同文件串行条件已满足 —— PR #3588 已落 main)— 会话 `session_01GTRjn8xBqp75dk7kFupVRt`,分支 `claude/issue-3590-settings-btn-target`。

分诊:具体缺陷即派(零应用部署下空态两个按钮之一仍死:`/apps/setup` 就是本空态自己的 URL,点了原地不动)。修向按 issue 测量:目标应为系统枢纽真实可达地址 `/apps/setup/system`(isSystemRoute 需 `/system` 段)。⚠️ 三个调用点(AppContent、AppSidebar:313、UnifiedSidebar:318)—— 本单以 AppContent 的按钮为主修点;另两处同值是否同改,dev 先量各自语境(它们是"无 activeApp 的系统兜底导航",语义可能就是要落系统枢纽 —— 若是,同改并逐点证据),同 PR 内处理但逐点披露。#3588 新加的测试文件已存在,扩展它而非另起。

文件面:`packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`(该按钮)、`packages/app-shell/src/layout/{AppSidebar,UnifiedSidebar}.tsx`(仅同值调用点,按测量定)+ 测试。⚠️ 与在飞 #5316(metadata-admin)/#3546-s2(i18n)/#3363(types)/#3337(dashboard)零相交。越界即停。

裁决记录:
1. **UnifiedSidebar 钉「绿-不变」接受为诚实方向**:该 href 修正因 home 臂平铺渲染(#3609)处于休眠,测试钉的是「组被平铺」这一与 URL 常量无关的事实 — 报红才是造假。
2. 深层 splat URL 的绝对目标断言(depth-independent)正确落实了 #3573/#3588 确立的 app-scoped absolute 契约。
3. 新发现三单入池,**全部与本 PR 同文件,串行等 3608 落 main 再派**:#3609(UnifiedSidebar home 臂不递归,9 个管理入口从不进 DOM)、#3610(零 app 的 sys-objects 路由白屏,无 catch-all)、#3611(同族 4 处裸 `/apps/setup` 残留)。
